{"CommandLine":"python -c "
import requests, json, os

session = requests.Session()
BASE_URL = 'http://localhost:5000/api'
results = []
bugs = []
ts = '2026-09-24T10:24:00+02:00'

def log(test_id, name, status, details, bug=None):
    r = {'test_id': test_id, 'name': name, 'status': status, 'details': str(details)[:800]}
    results.append(r)
    if bug:
        bugs.append(bug)
    print(f'[{test_id}] {name}: {status} | {str(details)[:300]}')

def csrf_and_login():
    # Login first
    r = session.post(f'{BASE_URL}/auth/login', json={'email': 'a', 'password': 'a'})
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Login failed: {r.text}'
    # Get CSRF
    r2 = session.get(f'{BASE_URL}/csrf-token')
    assert r2.status_code == 200, f'CSRF failed: {r2.text}'
    csrf = r2.json().get('csrf_token')
    session.headers.update({'X-CSRFToken': csrf})
    return csrf

csrf = csrf_and_login()
log('T01', 'Login + CSRF', 'PASS', f'CSRF obtained, session cookie set')

# ===== T02: Dashboard BEFORE =====
r = session.get(f'{BASE_URL}/dashboard/summary')
print(f'Dashboard summary raw: {r.status_code} {r.text[:500]}')
before_total = None
before_raw = None
if r.status_code == 200:
    data = r.json()
    before_raw = data
    # It's a list - find total row
    if isinstance(data, list):
        total_row = next((d for d in data if d.get('facility_id') == 'total'), None)
        if total_row:
            before_total = total_row.get('scope1_total', 0) + total_row.get('scope2_total', 0)
        else:
            before_total = sum(d.get('scope1_total', 0) for d in data)
        log('T02', 'Dashboard Summary BEFORE (list response)', 'PASS', f'total={before_total}, rows={len(data)}')
    elif isinstance(data, dict):
        before_total = data.get('total_emissions') or data.get('totalEmissions') or 0
        log('T02', 'Dashboard Summary BEFORE', 'PASS', f'total={before_total}')
    else:
        log('T02', 'Dashboard Summary BEFORE', 'FAIL', 'Unexpected response type')
else:
    log('T02', 'Dashboard Summary BEFORE', 'FAIL', f'HTTP {r.status_code}')

# ===== T03: POST emission =====
EMIT_ID = None
payload = {'source_type': 'Combustion', 'sub_type': 'Stationary', 'fuel_type': 'Natural Gas',
           'quantity': 9999.0, 'unit': 'MMBtu', 'facility_id': 1, 'year': 2024, 'month': 12, 'notes': 'Integrity test'}
r = session.post(f'{BASE_URL}/emissions', json=payload)
print(f'POST emission: {r.status_code} {r.text[:400]}')
if r.status_code in [200, 201]:
    data = r.json()
    EMIT_ID = data.get('id') or data.get('emission_id') or (data.get('emission') or {}).get('id') or (data.get('data') or {}).get('id')
    if not EMIT_ID and isinstance(data, dict):
        for k, v in data.items():
            if isinstance(v, dict) and 'id' in v:
                EMIT_ID = v['id']
                break
    log('T03', 'POST Emission', 'PASS', f'EMIT_ID={EMIT_ID}, response={str(data)[:200]}')
else:
    log('T03', 'POST Emission', 'FAIL', f'HTTP {r.status_code} {r.text[:200]}')
    bugs.append({'id': 'BUG-09-01', 'severity': 'HIGH', 'title': 'Cannot create emission - CSRF/auth issue blocking writes',
                 'endpoint': 'POST /api/emissions', 'expected': 'HTTP 200/201', 'actual': f'HTTP {r.status_code}'})

# ===== T04: Dashboard AFTER =====
r = session.get(f'{BASE_URL}/dashboard/summary')
after_total = None
if r.status_code == 200:
    data = r.json()
    if isinstance(data, list):
        total_row = next((d for d in data if d.get('facility_id') == 'total'), None)
        if total_row:
            after_total = total_row.get('scope1_total', 0) + total_row.get('scope2_total', 0)
        else:
            after_total = sum(d.get('scope1_total', 0) for d in data)
    else:
        after_total = data.get('total_emissions') or data.get('totalEmissions') or 0
    if before_total is not None and after_total is not None and EMIT_ID:
        changed = abs(float(after_total) - float(before_total)) > 0.001
        status = 'PASS' if changed else 'FAIL'
        log('T04', 'Dashboard updated after add', status, f'before={before_total}, after={after_total}')
        if not changed:
            bugs.append({'id': 'BUG-09-02', 'severity': 'HIGH', 'title': 'Dashboard total not updated after emission added',
                         'endpoint': 'GET /api/dashboard/summary', 'expected': f'total > {before_total}', 'actual': f'{after_total}'})
    else:
        log('T04', 'Dashboard updated after add', 'SKIP', f'Cannot compare: before={before_total}, after={after_total}, emit_id={EMIT_ID}')
else:
    log('T04', 'Dashboard updated after add', 'FAIL', f'HTTP {r.status_code}')

# ===== T05: DELETE emission =====
if EMIT_ID:
    r = session.delete(f'{BASE_URL}/emissions/{EMIT_ID}')
    print(f'DELETE emission {EMIT_ID}: {r.status_code} {r.text[:200]}')
    log('T05', 'DELETE Emission', 'PASS' if r.status_code in [200, 204] else 'FAIL', f'HTTP {r.status_code}')
else:
    log('T05', 'DELETE Emission', 'SKIP', 'No EMIT_ID to delete')

# ===== T06: Dashboard AFTER DELETE =====
r = session.get(f'{BASE_URL}/dashboard/summary')
if r.status_code == 200 and before_total is not None and EMIT_ID:
    data = r.json()
    if isinstance(data, list):
        total_row = next((d for d in data if d.get('facility_id') == 'total'), None)
        after_del = (total_row.get('scope1_total', 0) + total_row.get('scope2_total', 0)) if total_row else sum(d.get('scope1_total', 0) for d in data)
    else:
        after_del = data.get('total_emissions') or 0
    diff = abs(float(after_del) - float(before_total))
    ok = diff < 1.0
    log('T06', 'Dashboard reverted after DELETE', 'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL', f'before={before_total}, after_del={after_del}, diff={diff:.4f}')
    if not ok:
        bugs.append({'id': 'BUG-09-03', 'severity': 'HIGH', 'title': 'Dashboard did not revert after emission deleted',
                     'endpoint': 'GET /api/dashboard/summary', 'expected': f'~{before_total}', 'actual': str(after_del)})
else:
    log('T06', 'Dashboard reverted after DELETE', 'SKIP', 'Cannot compare')

# ===== T07: Scope breakdown =====
r = session.get(f'{BASE_URL}/dashboard/scope-breakdown')
print(f'scope-breakdown: {r.status_code} {r.text[:400]}')
if r.status_code == 200:
    data = r.json()
    has_s1 = any('scope1' in str(k).lower() or str(v).lower() in ['scope 1','scope1'] for item in (data if isinstance(data, list) else [data]) for k,v in (item.items() if isinstance(item, dict) else {}.items()))
    log('T07', 'Scope breakdown present', 'PASS', f'Response: {str(data)[:300]}')
else:
    log('T07', 'Scope breakdown', 'FAIL', f'HTTP {r.status_code}')
    bugs.append({'id': 'BUG-09-04', 'severity': 'HIGH', 'title': 'Scope breakdown endpoint failed',
                 'endpoint': 'GET /api/dashboard/scope-breakdown', 'expected': 'HTTP 200', 'actual': f'HTTP {r.status_code}'})

# ===== T08: Facility breakdown =====
r = session.get(f'{BASE_URL}/dashboard/facility-breakdown')
print(f'facility-breakdown: {r.status_code} {r.text[:300]}')
log('T08', 'Facility breakdown', 'PASS' if r.status_code == 200 else 'FAIL', f'HTTP {r.status_code} {r.text[:100]}')
if r.status_code != 200:
    bugs.append({'id': 'BUG-09-05', 'severity': 'MEDIUM', 'title': 'Facility breakdown endpoint failed',
                 'endpoint': 'GET /api/dashboard/facility-breakdown', 'expected': 'HTTP 200', 'actual': f'HTTP {r.status_code}'})

# ===== T09: Intensity trend =====
r = session.get(f'{BASE_URL}/dashboard/intensity-trend')
print(f'intensity-trend: {r.status_code} {r.text[:300]}')
log('T09', 'Intensity trend', 'PASS' if r.status_code == 200 else 'FAIL', f'HTTP {r.status_code} {r.text[:150]}')
if r.status_code != 200:
    bugs.append({'id': 'BUG-09-06', 'severity': 'MEDIUM', 'title': 'Intensity trend endpoint failed',
                 'endpoint': 'GET /api/dashboard/intensity-trend', 'expected': 'HTTP 200', 'actual': f'HTTP {r.status_code}'})

print(json.dumps({'results': results, 'bugs': bugs}, indent=2))
" 2>&1
